name: decode_poem
description: decode throughput: tiny prompt, long generation
instruction: Write a poem of exactly fourteen four-line stanzas about a container ship being loaded at night. Keep the language plain and concrete, number each stanza, and end every stanza with a question.
notes: Short prompt, long structured generation, so nearly all wall time is single-token steps: this is the number specification/07.4 rooflines against. Measured behaviour: the model writes a few stanzas and stops on its own around 250-300 tokens, so the floor is 180 and max_new_tokens is a ceiling, not a target.
